description: Does a test-authoring skill produce a suite that would actually have caught the bug? Twelve cases over examples/fixtures/quoting-service, a stdlib-only parcel quoting service. Each treatment case asks for tests over one slice of the service and is graded on three mechanical signals computed at gate time: the mutation kill rate against the fixture, the share of the seeded defects in seeded_defects.json the suite goes red on, and the four rule-based qe-review rubric dimensions (assertion strength, flake resistance, changed-line coverage, absence of tautological assertions). The twelfth case is a distractor with no testing work in it: the skill must stay silent.
